confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from automated SQL injection attempts to a successful account takeover/compromise of user_09, followed by privilege escalation, massive database querying, large-scale data exfiltration to a known malicious domain, and finally, an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Automated SQL injection attempts using sqlmap against the web server from IP 162.247.74.27.
Successful login of user_09 from the same suspicious IP (162.247.74.27) during off-hours.
Privilege escalation where user_09 was elevated to 'dba' status.
Lateral movement to the production database (prod_main) using the elevated credentials.
Massive database queries targeting the 'customers' table, affecting hundreds of thousands of rows.
Data exfiltration via DNS tunneling (UDP/53) to a malicious domain 'x4215.malicious-84.com'.
Large-scale data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP/443) totaling approximately 183.5 MB.
Anti-forensic activity: deletion/truncation of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide the intrusion.

gaps: Verification of whether user_09's actual credentials were stolen via the SQL injection or if the SQL injection was a distraction.
Confirmation of the exact contents of the exfiltrated data.
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection attempts to facilitate the compromise of user_09's account, subsequently escalating privileges to DBA. The attacker then queried large volumes of customer data and exfiltrated it via both DNS tunneling and HTTPS to a malicious domain before deleting system logs to hide their presence.
